trigger: The second guarded preparation stopped at the internal memory limit while reading HCT116 batch 20.
cause: Filtered PyArrow list-column buffers were retained by the allocator between batches. A bounded follow-up probe also found that decoding token IDs and expression values together created a single-batch high-water spike near the outer guard.
repair: Read exact Non-Targeting and NEGR1 expression in separate Arrow-native filtered tables.
Construct the legacy reconstruction sum as exact Non-Targeting plus NEGR1, which is exact because the frozen metadata audit proves there are no other eligible legacy matches.
Decode sparse token IDs and expression values in separate filtered reads, copying only the selected token vector between them.
Release Arrow allocator pages after each large list-column read and after every batch.
